watch.text: Tim Polasek said QB Nathan Hayes is 'dealing with like three different injuries' and working to get back out there this week; Hayes played all of the 31-25 win over NIU.
S Darius Givance (back), out since leaving the Oct. 10 UNLV game, is trending toward returning for San José State; TEs Reis Kessel and Luke Kokat (ankles) are on track to play.
RB CJ Baxter (RB1 in 10 of 11 games) and RT Malachi Wood were hurt at Missouri; Will Stein calls both day to day, likely game-time decisions for Louisville. No newer update found.
Boise State's Nov. 28 game at Colorado State is a Pac-12 flex game that doesn't count in the standings; the Broncos host San Diego State in the Pac-12 title game on Dec. 4.
Starting QB Micah Alejado (left knee, hurt in the 16-8 loss at Nevada) is out for the Sacramento State finale; Bjorn Jurgensen, a Virginia transfer, makes his first career start.
Texas Tech listed RB Quinten Joyner (missed the last 2 games) and S Miquel Dingle Jr. out and OLB LaDamion Guyton doubtful on Monday's initial Big 12 availability report for the TCU game.
WR Coy Eakin, who missed the Oklahoma State and Baylor games, is probable and Joey McGuire expects him back; RB Cam Dickey is 'close to 100%', McGuire said.
QB Jaden Craig (ankle) is out for Texas Tech on Monday's initial Big 12 availability report after missing the Utah loss; sophomore Adam Schobel (15-of-31, 2 INTs vs Utah) makes his 2nd start.
TCU parted ways with Sonny Dykes on Nov. 22 after the 38-17 home loss to Utah; defensive coordinator Andy Avalos is interim coach for the Texas Tech game.
QB Bishop Davenport missed 6 games (Sept. 19-Oct. 31) and has started the last 3 since returning Nov. 7 (2-1); the games without him still weigh on our rating.
Starting QB Angel Flores (concussion, then ankle surgery) is out for the rest of 2026 and has missed the last 4 games; Jadyn Glasser starts. Our rating still carries Flores' earlier starts.
Coach Blake Anderson replaced Landry Lyddy with dual-threat John White as the starter on Nov. 5; Southern Miss is 0-3 in White's starts.
Matt Campbell ruled out RB James Peoples for Maryland, RB Carson Hansen (missed Rutgers) is uncertain; CB Jahmir Joseph and DE Caleb Bacon practiced Tuesday after missing recent games.

RB Dierre Hill Jr. (left leg, in a boot) left the Michigan State win and RB Jordon Davison has missed 3 games; Dan Lanning doesn't expect Hill's injury to be long-term. Freshman Brandon Smith leads the backfield.
QB Keelon Russell (ankle) sat out the Nov. 21 Chattanooga win (Austin Mack started); DeBoer said Nov. 23 he expects him 'full go' all week for Auburn.
Mike Norvell was fired after the Oct. 31 home loss to Clemson; interim Rick Stockstill is 2-1 and says Ashton Daniels (FBS-high 14 INTs) stays the starter.
FSU had its top four RBs out (No. 5 Zay Parks started) in the 28-10 home loss to NC State on Nov. 21; edge Rylan Kennedy and RB Amari Thomas are out for the season.
C Drew Bobo (back) missed the last two games; Kirby Smart: 'We think he'll be able to play this week.' There is no SEC availability report for the nonconference Georgia Tech game.
QB Grady Adamson broke his collarbone in the Nov. 21 home loss to Wake Forest and is out; Alberto Mendoza also left hurt and is a game-time call, so No. 3 Graham Knowles may start.
CB Ja'Boree Antoine (out all season since fall camp) and RG Max Buchanan (knee, hurt vs Clemson Oct. 3) are back practicing; Cristobal says both may play Boston College.
WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery) has missed the last 3 games; Cristobal said Nov. 20 a return is possible within about two weeks, which puts the Dec. 5 ACC title game in range.
CB Ja'Boree Antoine (out all season since fall camp) and RG Max Buchanan (knee, hurt vs Clemson Oct. 3) are back practicing; Cristobal says both could play BC.
WR Malachi Toney (ankle surgery) has missed the last 3 games and is expected to miss Boston College too; Cristobal put him 'probably a week and a half out' on Nov. 20.
Miami has already clinched the ACC title game vs Wake Forest on Dec. 5, so the Boston College finale carries little at stake.
QB Aidan Chiles (upper body) has missed the last three games (all losses) and Braun gave no return date this week; Nicco Marchiol has started all three.
Temple has not picked a QB for Memphis: Jaxon Smolik (started the Rice loss) and Ajani Sheppard (ankle; started vs UAB) are both practicing, K.C. Keeler said Nov. 23.
Coach Scotty Walden was fired (interim Kyle Beyer); QB EJ Colson has missed the last three games with Raymond Moore III starting, and no return for Northern Illinois has been confirmed.
RB Ty Clark (team-high 591 rushing yards, 11 TDs) is out for the season after being hurt in the 50-29 win at Georgia Tech, Jake Dickert said Nov. 23; Deuce Lawrence and Jamar Searcy step in.
Wake Forest has clinched the ACC title game vs Miami, so the Duke finale carries less at stake for it.
RB Ty Clark (team-high 591 rushing yards, 11 TDs) is out for the season after being hurt in the 50-29 win at Georgia Tech, Jake Dickert said Monday; Deuce Lawrence and Jamar Searcy step in.
Washington State (2-9) has slumped, capped by a 42-14 loss at Texas State on Nov. 21; QB Owen Eshelman played the whole game, no injury reported.
Fickell again would not name a starter for Minnesota ('no declarations right this minute'); Colton Joseph started the 42-10 win at Purdue after Ryan Hopkins was hurt Nov. 14.
Starting S Matt Jung (season, surgery) and starting CB Javan Robinson were hurt at Maryland Nov. 14; Jung is out and Robinson doubtful again for Minnesota.
Minnesota fired OC/QB coach Greg Harbaugh after the Penn State loss; Fleck hasn't named the play caller, and the Gophers beat Northwestern 20-17 in the first game since.
DTs Theorin Randle, Riley Sunram and Jaylin Hicks (season, since the UCLA game) are all out again on the Nov. 24 availability report; starting C Ashton Beers is out for the year.
Top WR Jackson Harris (864 yards) left the Nov. 21 loss at Tennessee at halftime with a lower-leg injury after 2 catches; no update yet for Arkansas.
WR Mike Matthews (knee) is out for the season; RB DeSean Bishop (left the LSU game) 'looked good' Nov. 23 and Heupel will decide through the week.
Lea on QB Jared Curtis (aggravated wrist): 'I expect him to practice. I expect him to play.' OL Clinton Azubuike (ankle) and Lyndon Cooper (shoulder) expected questionable.
QB Alonza Barnett III missed five games (Sept. 19-Oct. 24, hamstring) and has played the last four since Oct. 30; ratings still carry the games without him.
QB Michael Van Buren was hurt Oct. 31 vs UAB; Luke Kromenhoek has started the last three, all losses, and no return has been announced.
USF parted ways with offensive coordinator Tim Beck after the Nov. 21 loss at FAU; a new play caller has one week before the Tulane finale.
Starting QB Jay Kastantin (9 starts) was hurt Oct. 31 and Eddie George said he will probably miss the rest of the year; Austin Novosad has started the last two games.
QB Pop Watson (ankle) was hurt early at Toledo, missed the Akron game, and is 'probably not' playing at Bowling Green; Logan Inagawa starts.
QB Tyler Hughes (small right forearm fracture) has missed the last two games; backup Landon Sims went 1-1 and no return has been announced.
Head coach Jay Sawvel is serving a self-imposed one-game suspension (recruiting-contact violations); DE coach Brian Hendricks is acting head coach vs UConn.
Jason Eck benched Toa Fa'avae for Luke Moga, who won his first career start 24-17 at Wyoming (234 yards passing, 1 TD, plus a rushing TD).
Leading rusher Scottre Humphrey (762 yards, 14 TDs) hurt his ankle in the first quarter at Wyoming; after an MRI Eck said he is neither ruled out nor ruled in for Air Force.
Mike Elko has not picked a QB for Texas: Marcel Reed was benched vs Tennessee and Brady Hart started the 28-7 loss at Oklahoma.
Tuesday's SEC availability report rules out S Marcus Ratcliffe (missed Oklahoma), DT Landon Rink (illness), OL Trovon Baugh and OL Blake Ivy for Texas; DE Marco Jones (leg) is questionable.
Starting WRs TK Norman and Ashton Bethel-Roman are among at least seven Aggies out for Texas, on an offense held to 9 points or fewer in five of its last six SEC games.
S Kobe Black (knee, hurt vs Arkansas) is out for the season per Steve Sarkisian; DT Hero Kanu (biceps surgery) could 'potentially' return for the playoffs.
Edge Colin Simmons (high ankle, missed the Arkansas win), RT Andre Cojoe and edge Richard Wesley are questionable on Tuesday's SEC availability report for Texas A&M.
RB Wayshawn Parker (heel bruise) has 23 carries in the last four games and may be rested vs West Virginia; Utah has already clinched a Big 12 title game spot.
QB Michael Hawkins Jr. (ankle, hurt again in the Houston loss) is doubtful for Utah on the Big 12 availability report; Scotty Fox Jr. is expected to make the start.
QB Steve Angeli (AC joint, right shoulder, hurt Nov. 21 at BC) ruled out vs Notre Dame by Fran Brown; Malachi Nelson starts. Our ratings were built with Angeli.
S Luke Talich (torn Achilles vs SMU, team leader with 3 INTs) is out for the season; LB Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa (knee) and WR Jaden Greathouse (hand) are ruled out for Syracuse.
QB Avery Johnson has been out since October and is expected to miss the finale; Dillon Duff has started since, so our ratings still carry Johnson's early starts.
Collin Klein called QB Dillon Duff 'day to day' after hard hits vs Arizona; Blake Barnett is next if Duff can't play at Iowa State.
QB Tait Reynolds is out for the season and backup Christopher Vizzina (concussion) 'definitely will not be back'; third-stringer Trent Pearman starts vs South Carolina.
Swinney expects LB Jeremiah Alexander back after missing Duke and hopes WR Tyler Brown and CB Elliot Washington II (upper body, didn't dress at Duke) return for South Carolina.
QB LaNorris Sellers (ankle) missed the Arkansas loss and returned vs Georgia on Nov. 21; our ratings carry the game without him.
WR Mazeo Bennett Jr., EDGE Anthony Addison and CB Judge Collier missed the Georgia loss; Beamer said Bennett and Addison practiced Tuesday and Collier should be ready for Clemson.
QB Ty Dieffenbach (hip) was carted off in OT at Michigan Nov. 21; he practiced Monday and Tuesday but is not cleared for USC. Madden Iamaleava is next; Nico Iamaleava is out for the year.
Cignetti said C Bray Lynch (lower leg) 'doesn't look good' for Purdue; G Joe Brunner is out for the year (knee). He is 'optimistic we'll get quite a few guys back this week.'
QB undecided for Purdue: Grant Wilson started the last two games while Josh Hoover (right shoulder) was hurt; Hoover relieved him at Washington, and both get first-team reps.
RB Kewan Lacy is out for the season and RB Shekai Mills-Knight (high ankle) is questionable on Tuesday's SEC availability report; OL Patrick Kutas, who missed the last 2 games, is doubtful.
DL Kam Franklin (hamstring), held out vs Wofford, is probable and Will Echoles is off the report; Pete Golding takes back defensive play-calling for the Egg Bowl.
Starter Kamario Taylor has missed the last 4 games (season over); AJ Swann (left foot) is doubtful on Tuesday's SEC report, so Puckett, who started the Tennessee Tech win, likely starts.
RB Fluff Bothwell, who missed the Nov. 21 Tennessee Tech game, is not on Tuesday's SEC availability report.
QB Billy Edwards Jr. was hurt Nov. 14 vs Louisville and sat out the Nov. 21 loss at Virginia; Belichick won't name a starter between him and Travis Burgess for NC State.
RB Duke Scott, back from a lower-body injury, was hurt again in the 28-10 win at Florida State (7 carries, 24 yards); his status for North Carolina is unknown.
Interim coach Todd Goebbel has led the team since Dave Doeren's firing (2-2 in those games); Philip Rivers has been named the 2027 coach.
Landon Varnes has started the last three games (KSU 3-0) after Rickie Collins was benched and then hurt; KSU was 2-6 before, and Collins was questionable on the C-USA report on Nov. 21.
Starting QB Cameran Brown has missed the last 4 games and is out again for Louisiana, per 247Sports via Rotowire; Ayden Pereira starts.
Liberty (10-1) has clinched the CUSA title game vs Jacksonville State next week, so the Missouri State finale carries little at stake; no injuries reported.
QB Kevin Jennings rolled his ankle in the 2nd quarter of the Nov. 21 loss at Notre Dame and was limited, per Lashlee; no status update found yet for Stanford.
LB Luke Mergott (leg, hurt before halftime vs Clemson) is out for the season, Manny Diaz said Monday; Will Felder takes more snaps. Diaz hopes to have CB Kyon Loud back.
Starter Dylan Lonergan (head injury) has missed the last 5 games; AJ Surace, who played through broken ribs, started all of them (1-4), including the 25-24 win at Penn State.
QB Alessio Milivojevic (left arm, hurt vs Washington) wore a brace and looks unlikely at Rutgers; Kayd Coffman started the 45-7 loss to Oregon, and Cam Fancher (knee) is a toss-up.
Cal (3-8) has lost five straight; Tosh Lupoi says he expects to stay but confirmed several talks with GM Ron Rivera and declined details.
QB Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele (sore ankle) was mostly used at receiver early in the Big Game while Dominic Ingrassia ran the offense; no QB plan for Pitt announced.
QB Mason Heintschel tore his ACL in the Oct. 2 win at Virginia Tech; Pitt is 1-5 since, and Narduzzi says practice this week decides between Holden Geriner and Corey Dailey.
QB Conner Weigman (shoulder) missed the West Virginia win; he will practice to some degree this week, decision by Thursday or Friday; else Keisean Henderson starts.
Baylor fired Dave Aranda after the Oct. 24 loss at Kansas; interim coach Joe Klanderman is 2-2.
QB Julian Sayin (right elbow) has missed four games since Oct. 17 (OSU 1-3) and is not expected back for Michigan; Luke Fahey starts. Ratings still carry Sayin's games.
RB Ja'Kobi Jackson (foot) hasn't played since the Oct. 10 Maryland game and is considered unlikely to return for Michigan, per CBS Sports.
QB Bryce Underwood has a lower-body injury from the Nov. 21 UCLA win; Whittingham says he starts at Ohio State barring a setback. RB Jordan Marshall is hoped back but not cleared.
WR J.J. Buchanan (shoulder) got hurt Nov. 14 at Oregon, missed the UCLA game and is out for the year, Whittingham said.
Army lost 10-6 to East Carolina on Nov. 21 without three starting offensive linemen (C Brady Small, Kyle Kloska, Henry Appleton); Paolo Gennarelli also left hurt. No update for Rice.
Butch Jones was fired on Nov. 17; associate head coach Jalen Ortiz is interim for the last two games, and the first was a 48-3 loss at Louisiana Tech on Nov. 22.
QB Goose Crowder missed the Oct. 29 JMU and Nov. 7 Louisiana Tech games (Tucker Kilcrease started, 1-1) and has started the last two since returning Nov. 15.
RB LJ Martin (high ankle sprain Oct. 3 at TCU) missed four games, returned on light work Nov. 7 and ran 25 times for 127 yards at Kansas on Nov. 21; Sitake says BYU is near full strength.
Starting QB Tayven Jackson (upper body) is out for UAB, and backup Chris Jimerson Jr. (knee, hurt Nov. 21 at Tulane) is out for the season, Neal Brown confirmed.
With Chaston Ditta 'not going to be ready,' slot receiver James Tyre (4-of-7 at Tulane) could start at quarterback vs UAB.
QB Braden Atkinson (right hand, hurt vs Texas State Nov. 8) is out at Fresno State, his third straight missed game; Maalik Murphy starts again (OSU 1-1 in his starts).

401864549.summary: No one is ruled out, but NDSU QB Nathan Hayes is playing through three injuries and the line has come down from NDSU -10 to -8.5; NDSU still needs this win for a Mountain West title-game spot.

reasons.text: Tim Polasek said Hayes is 'dealing with like three different injuries' and working to get back out there this week; Hayes played the whole 31-25 win over NIU.
NDSU (9-2) needs to beat San José State to most likely earn a top-two spot for the Dec. 4 title game; a Nevada win over UNLV would put the Bison in regardless.
San José State (5-7) fell 24-22 to UNLV on Nov. 22 when Luke Weaver's tying 2-point pass fell incomplete; Weaver played the whole game.

returning.text: Safety out since leaving the Oct. 10 UNLV game (back); trending toward returning this week, per Polasek.

401856761.summary: Nothing found justifies Kentucky being only a short home dog: Kentucky has lost three of four and its RB1 and right tackle are game-time calls, which points our way; the home rivalry spot is the likely reason.

reasons.text: Kentucky has lost three of its last four (at Tennessee, vs Florida, at Missouri); Louisville has won six straight, the last 42-10 over Pitt.
RB CJ Baxter and RT Malachi Wood (hurt at Missouri) are day to day, likely game-time decisions, Will Stein said; no newer update found.
Stein calls it 'the most important game for us as a program' and wants Kroger Field 'electric': a home rivalry spot, the likely source of the market's number.

swings.Louisville: Louisville beat Pitt 42-10 on Nov. 22, its sixth straight win; no new injury found. The swing mostly reflects our model change on Nov. 24.
swings.Kentucky: Kentucky lost 28-14 at Missouri on Nov. 22, its third loss in four games, and RB CJ Baxter and RT Malachi Wood are day to day (Courier Journal).

401871062.summary: Jacksonville State has already clinched its CUSA title-game spot (vs Liberty on Dec. 4), so this game means less to it, though hosting is still possible; Delaware's passing game is hot (5 TD passes last week). No injury news on either side.

reasons.text: Jax State clinched a CUSA title-game berth with a 25-20 comeback win over Missouri State on Nov. 21; Liberty, a game ahead, is the opponent, with the better record hosting.
Delaware QB Nick Minicucci threw 5 TDs (31-of-41, 398 yds) in a 42-30 win at New Mexico State; the Blue Hens are 6-5.

swings.Delaware: Delaware won 42-30 at New Mexico State on Nov. 21 with Nick Minicucci throwing 5 TDs and the market moved up on the Blue Hens; part of the swing is our model change on Nov. 24.

401860926.summary: This is a Pac-12 flex game that doesn't count in the standings, and Boise State hosts San Diego State for the title six days later, so the market shades Boise's effort; no injury news either way. Winds near 19 mph also cut scoring.

reasons.text: The Pac-12's four Week 13 flex games, including Boise State at Colorado State, count as non-conference games and not in the league standings.
San Diego State beat Boise State 22-20 on a final-play field goal Nov. 21, setting up the Dec. 4 title-game rematch in Boise; Maddux Madsen played the whole game.
Colorado State (3-8) allowed 73 points at Washington State and 49 at Fresno State in its last two games.

401864547.summary: Hawai'i's starting QB Micah Alejado is out and Bjorn Jurgensen makes his first career start; that covers a good part, though not all, of our 10-point gap with the market.

reasons.text: Alejado (left knee, hurt in the 16-8 loss at Nevada) was ruled out for the finale on Nov. 23; Timmy Chang said Jurgensen will make his first NCAA start.
Jurgensen, a January transfer from Virginia, went 8-of-15 after Alejado left at Nevada; coaches say he is ready.
Sacramento State (2-9) comes off a 17-day break, the longest in its single-season history, after playing four games in 19 days.

swings.Hawai'i: Starting QB Micah Alejado was ruled out for the finale after his knee injury at Nevada (Star-Advertiser, Nov. 23); the market priced the backup in, our ratings don't see it.

401862838.summary: Nothing found justifies the market's shorter Memphis number: Memphis has no injury news, and Temple's only change is an undecided QB between Jaxon Smolik and Ajani Sheppard.

reasons.text: Memphis lost 38-34 at Navy on Nov. 21 with QB Marcus Stokes playing the whole game and has allowed 135 points over its last four games; no injury reported.
Temple (2-9) has not named a starter: Smolik and Sheppard (ankle) are both practicing, K.C. Keeler said Nov. 23.

swings.Temple: Temple's QB is undecided between Smolik and Sheppard (Inquirer, Nov. 23); otherwise nothing new since the 31-27 loss to Rice on Nov. 20, so most of the swing is our Nov. 24 model change.

401858537.summary: Northwestern has lost all three games without QB Aidan Chiles and Braun gave no return date, which explains part of the market's shorter number.

reasons.text: Chiles (upper body) has missed the last three games, Nicco Marchiol starting; Northwestern lost all three and has lost four straight.
At his Nov. 24 game-week press conference Braun gave no update on Chiles playing Illinois.
Illinois lost 34-17 at home to Iowa on Nov. 21, its second straight loss, with QB Katin Houser playing; no new injury found.

swings.Illinois: Illinois lost 34-17 at home to Iowa on Nov. 21, its second straight loss; no injury news found. The swing mostly reflects our Nov. 24 model change.

401856760.summary: Nothing found justifies the market being 8 pts shorter on Georgia: Georgia Tech may be down to its third-string QB, and Georgia's only concern is C Drew Bobo, expected back.

reasons.text: Georgia Tech QB Grady Adamson (collarbone) is out and Alberto Mendoza is a game-time call; No. 3 Graham Knowles has not thrown a pass this season.
Georgia C Drew Bobo (back) missed two games; Kirby Smart expects him available, so his absence would explain little of the gap.
Georgia plays the SEC Championship Game on Dec. 5, the week after this rivalry game; no report of starters being held out.

swings.Georgia: Our line jumped after Georgia beat South Carolina 34-6 (Nov. 22) and Georgia Tech lost 50-29 at home to Wake Forest; the market opened Georgia -35.5 and hasn't moved, so we're now 8 pts higher on Georgia.
swings.Georgia Tech: Georgia Tech gave up 50 in the home loss to Wake Forest (Nov. 21) and lost QB Grady Adamson to a broken collarbone, with Mendoza uncertain (AP, Nov. 24); our rating fell and is 8 pts below the market's.

401860929.summary: Nothing found justifies the move to Washington State (opened 1, now 3): SDSU has clinched the Pac-12 title game but Sean Lewis says it will play to win, and WSU has no news.

reasons.text: SDSU beat Boise State 22-20 on Nov. 22 to clinch a Pac-12 title-game rematch at Boise on Dec. 4; Lewis said he won't rest key players: 'Play to win the games.'
Washington State lost 42-14 at Texas State on Nov. 21 and is 2-9; QB Owen Eshelman played the whole game.
Stone Saunders has started SDSU's last four games since Jayden Denegal's ankle injury vs Fresno State; SDSU beat Washington State 26-20 on Oct. 31.

401858318.summary: Neutral-site ACC title game (Dec. 5): the market leans on Miami's 33-20 win at Wake Forest in September, Wake losing RB Ty Clark and Miami getting starters back; our line rides Wake's eight straight wins, several over weak teams.

reasons.text: Miami beat Wake Forest 33-20 at Wake on Sept. 18; Wake has won eight straight since, including 77-0 over FCS Merrimack and 57-3 over Stanford.
Wake Forest leading rusher Ty Clark III is out for the season, Jake Dickert said Nov. 23.
Miami CB Ja'Boree Antoine and RG Max Buchanan are back at practice and WR Malachi Toney is close to returning, Cristobal said.

returning.text: CB, out all season since fall camp, back at practice; may play Boston College.
RG, hurt vs Clemson Oct. 3, back at practice.
WR, missed the last 3 games after ankle surgery; Cristobal eyes a return within about two weeks (Nov. 20).

swings.Wake Forest: Wake beat Georgia Tech 50-29 on Nov. 21, lifting our rating, but lost RB Ty Clark for the season (CBS, Nov. 23); the market kept Miami favored in a line set before both teams play this weekend.
swings.Miami: Miami beat Virginia Tech 28-20 on Nov. 22 and is getting CB Ja'Boree Antoine and RG Max Buchanan back (On3, Nov. 24); the market held Miami favored while our model moved toward Wake.

swings.Auburn: No Auburn injury news found; Auburn beat FCS Samford 59-17 on Nov. 21 with Byrum Brown not playing (Tristan Ti'a took the snaps), and Alabama QB Keelon Russell, out vs Chattanooga, is expected back (AL.com, Nov. 23).

401858544.summary: Nothing found that covers a 12-point gap: Wisconsin's QB is undeclared but both options are healthy, its thin secondary was the same in the 42-10 win at Purdue, and Minnesota's DT and center absences aren't new.

reasons.text: Fickell would not declare Colton Joseph or Ryan Hopkins the starter ('no declarations right this minute'); Joseph ran for 187 yards at Purdue. Wisconsin is 5-0 at home.
Wisconsin's report has S Matt Jung and CB Cai Bates out and CB Javan Robinson doubtful, the same as for the Purdue game.
Minnesota lists 10 players out, including DTs Randle, Sunram and Hicks and C Ashton Beers, and fired OC Greg Harbaugh before the 20-17 win over Northwestern.

swings.Minnesota: Minnesota beat Northwestern 20-17 on Nov. 21 in its first game after firing OC Greg Harbaugh; its DT absences carried over, nothing new found (Pioneer Press).
swings.Wisconsin: Wisconsin won 42-10 at Purdue on Nov. 21 behind Colton Joseph (187 rushing yards); Fickell hasn't formally named him the starter for Minnesota (AP).

401856758.summary: LSU's top WR Jackson Harris left the Tennessee loss hurt and has no update, which is real but small next to a 6-point gap; LSU has lost three straight.

reasons.text: WR Jackson Harris (864 yards, 9 TDs) left the Nov. 21 game at Tennessee at halftime with a lower-leg injury; S Ty Benefield was ejected for first-half targeting.
LSU lost 27-13 at Tennessee on Nov. 21, its third straight loss (Alabama, Texas, Tennessee); Kiffin called it 'an offensive issue.'
Arkansas (4-7) lost 45-3 at Texas on Nov. 21 and is out of bowl contention, which would favor our side.

swings.LSU: LSU lost 27-13 at Tennessee on Nov. 21, its third straight loss, and lost top WR Jackson Harris to a lower-leg injury at halftime (EssentiallySports).

401862839.summary: USF has lost three straight with backup Luke Kromenhoek and fired OC Tim Beck a week before the finale; that covers part of the gap, though Van Buren's absence is already in our ratings.

reasons.text: USF lost 35-14 at Florida Atlantic on Nov. 21, its third straight loss; Kromenhoek played the whole game.
USF and offensive coordinator Tim Beck parted ways after 11 games; the new play caller gets one week for Tulane.
Starter Michael Van Buren was hurt vs UAB on Oct. 31; no return news found, and Kromenhoek has started the last three.

401856765.summary: Tennessee is without WR Mike Matthews and RB DeSean Bishop is day to day, covering some of the gap; the market has moved from 11.5 to 13.5 toward our Tennessee side.

reasons.text: WR Mike Matthews (knee) is out for the season.
RB DeSean Bishop (left the LSU game) 'looked good' Nov. 23; Heupel will decide through the week, with Javin Gordon next.
Lea expects Vanderbilt QB Jared Curtis to practice and play; OL Clinton Azubuike and Lyndon Cooper expected questionable.

swings.Massachusetts: Harasymiak said Nov. 24 QB Pop Watson (ankle) is probably out at Bowling Green after missing the 34-33 loss to Akron; Logan Inagawa starts (Minuteman Command).

401856880.summary: Nothing found justifies a shorter Utah line: WVU QB Michael Hawkins Jr. is doubtful, and the line has already moved from Utah -21 to -25.5 toward our number.

reasons.text: WVU QB Michael Hawkins Jr. (ankle) is doubtful on the Big 12 availability report; Scotty Fox Jr. is expected to start.
Utah (11-0) has clinched a Big 12 title game spot, and RB Wayshawn Parker (heel) may be rested: a small lookahead risk the market may be pricing.
West Virginia (5-6) needs one more victory, in Friday's finale in Salt Lake City, to reach bowl eligibility.

401871082.summary: Nothing found: no injury or coaching news this week explains it; both teams are out of bowl contention, so the market is simply less sure of FIU than we are.

reasons.text: FIU (4-7) was eliminated from bowl contention by its 35-24 loss at Kennesaw State; Sam Houston (1-10) has lost six straight, the last 31-28 to Middle Tennessee.
Sam Houston, under co-interim coaches, has used DJ Bailey in relief of QB Landyn Locke (believed fibula fracture earlier) in recent games.

401858543.summary: UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach (hip) is practicing but not cleared, and USC opened -7 with that priced in; a starting QB explains part of a 14-point gap, not all of it.

reasons.text: Dieffenbach practiced Monday and Tuesday and threw some passes, but his status for USC is unclear; Madden Iamaleava is next.
Nico Iamaleava is out for the season (torn ACL vs Oregon on Oct. 10).
USC opened as a 7-point favorite on Sunday, after the injury, and has stayed around -7 at most books.

swings.UCLA: QB Ty Dieffenbach was carted off in OT at Michigan on Nov. 21 (hip; practicing but not cleared for USC per Chesney); our ratings don't see it, the market does.
swings.USC: Mostly the other side of UCLA's QB injury: Ty Dieffenbach was hurt Nov. 21 at Michigan and is uncertain, so the market leans USC (ESPN).

401858538.summary: Indiana is banged up on the line (C Bray Lynch 'doesn't look good', G Joe Brunner out for the year) and Cignetti won't name a QB between Grant Wilson and Josh Hoover, which covers part of the gap.

reasons.text: Cignetti won't name a QB: Grant Wilson started vs USC and at Washington, with Josh Hoover (shoulder) relieving him at Washington; both take first-team reps.
Cignetti: 'the only one that doesn't look good right now is Bray Lynch' (C, lower leg); G Joe Brunner is out for the season.

swings.Indiana: After the 27-24 loss at Washington (Nov. 21), Cignetti won't name a QB (Wilson or Hoover) and C Bray Lynch 'doesn't look good' (AP), so the market is lower on Indiana than we are.

401858314.summary: Syracuse starts Malachi Nelson for injured QB Steve Angeli while Notre Dame is missing several defensive starters; our line and the market now agree within a point.

reasons.text: Fran Brown ruled QB Steve Angeli out with a right AC joint injury from the Nov. 21 BC loss; Malachi Nelson starts.
Notre Dame is also short-handed: S Luke Talich (season), LBs Viliamu-Asa and Bowen, CB McKinney and WR Greathouse are out at Syracuse.
